Keywords: Dunhuang mother and daughter in debt
RagShortTexts: Shayn added that Farnkhund’s debts had made her and her mother servants of local Chinese people.

Variants.Content: Shayn added that Farnkhund’s debts had made her and her mother servants of local Chinese people. Her mother repeatedly sought passage to husband or natal family without securing it. Debt, kin support and mobility constrained this particular household; their experience cannot stand for every Sogdian woman.
